name: Sentinel Basic Care Package
summary: Sentinel Basic Care Package is a recognition of service provided to Alliance champions who take up arms for the Silverwing Sentinels. Offered by Illiyana Moonblaze in Ashenvale, this parcel equips frontline fighters with battlefield rations and bandages for the ongoing clash in Warsong Gulch.

sections.title: A Token of Trust
sections.body: The Silverwing Sentinels do not grant their trust lightly to outsiders, even those under the banner of the Grand Alliance. However, when an adventurer demonstrates willingness to bleed in defense of Ashenvale's ancient borders, the night elves acknowledge that commitment. Illiyana Moonblaze provides this package as a preliminary commendation for soldiers who have begun carving a name for themselves in the skirmishes against the Warsong Outriders.

sections.title: Provisions for the Front
sections.body: Warsong Gulch is a grinding battle of attrition, fought through dense canopies and fortified ramparts where regular supply lines struggle to reach. Inside this care package are specialty rations and medical supplies prepared exclusively for combat within the Gulch. As recruits deepen their standing among the Sentinels, higher-grade provisions and specialized stores become accessible, sustaining the continuous war effort against the Horde loggers.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this care package?
aliases: what is in the care package
faq.answer: The package serves as both an official recognition of your initial service to the Silverwing Sentinels and an emergency resupply. It contains rations and bandages designed exclusively to sustain fighters during skirmishes inside Warsong Gulch.

Illiyana Moonblaze, the supply officer for the Silverwing Sentinels located at Silverwing Grove in southern Ashenvale, issues the care package once you have proven your initial allegiance to their cause.

faq.q: Where can the supplies inside be used?
faq.answer: The provisions and bandages provided in the parcel are specially enchanted and stocked for combat operations strictly within the borders of Warsong Gulch. They cannot be utilized in the open world.

faq.q: How do you earn more advanced supplies from the Sentinels?
faq.answer: As you continue fighting the Warsong clan and improving your standing with the Silverwing Sentinels, standard provisions become purchasable. Rations become available at Friendly standing, while field bandages become accessible once you attain Honored rank.
After earning this initial parcel, further distinction on the battlefield allows you to earn the Sentinel Standard Care Package, which offers greater reinforcements for sustained conflict.

faq.q: Why are the Sentinels fighting in Warsong Gulch?
faq.answer: The Silverwing Sentinels fight to safeguard the ancient forests of Ashenvale from the logging operations of the Warsong Outriders, who seek lumber to build and sustain the Horde capital of Orgrimmar.

angles.text: The care package represents the growing military coordination between night elf defenders and the broader Alliance forces aiding their campaign in Kalimdor.
For night elf defenders, these provisions represent the shared sacrifices of the Sisterhood of Elune and the Sentinels to protect sacred ancestral woodland from Orcish axes.
